title: MiniMax H3 Video (self-hosted)
description: Renders one MiniMax H3 clip per job from open weights on your own GPU. Text-to-video, first-frame, and reference-to-video, with native audio. Weights live on a network volume so the container stays small and idle costs nothing.

input.name: Transformer quantization
input.description: pruned_fp8_scaled works on CUDA 12.8. Use pruned_int8_convrot only on a CUDA 13 build.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional. Only raises download rate limits; the weights are not gated.

input.name: S3 bucket endpoint
input.description: Optional but recommended. Must include the region, e.g. https://my-bucket.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Without it, clips over ~6.5MB cannot be returned.

input.name: S3 access key id
input.description: Optional, pairs with the bucket endpoint.

input.name: S3 secret access key
input.description: Optional, pairs with the bucket endpoint.
